decisions.reason: After the broader operator line was already withdrawn and this remote-control operator looks more like a feature or variant than a strategic standalone product, we would discontinue it and absorb any demand into the core range.
Because it overlaps with stronger glazed industrial door offers and had weaker visibility, we would rationalize the range and remove this variant.
This glazed industrial sectional door still fits the firm's core industrial access portfolio well enough to keep, although consolidation pressure makes the risk of withdrawal material.
